notes:
Composed of ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧ (real ability/power) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). Emphasizes actual power or competence rather than formal title. Often implies behind-the-scenes influence, especially in political contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}: political powerbroker
- ⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}: industry heavyweight
- ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}: local person of influence
- ⟦{隠|かく}れた→隠れる：02035_kakureru⟧{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}: hidden power player

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{有力者|ゆうりょくしゃ}→有力者：19082_yuuryokusha⟧: influential person — similar but emphasizes social standing and connections
- ⟦{権力者|けんりょくしゃ}→権力者：17021_kenryokusha⟧: person in power — focuses on formal authority
- ⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧: real ability, true strength — the base noun without the person suffix

definitions.explanation: a person who wields real power or has genuine ability; someone influential behind the scenes or through demonstrated competence

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業界|ぎょうかい}→業界：13129_gyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}だ。
examples.english: He is a powerful figure in the industry.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: I consulted with a local person of influence.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政界|せいかい}→政界：15196_seikai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{実力者|じつりょくしゃ}たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{裏|うら}→裏：02178_ura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}いていた→動く：00904_ugoku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: It was revealed that powerful political figures had been working behind the scenes.
